questions.question: On this day in 1923, which city officially replaced Istanbul to become the capital of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Situated in central Anatolia, Ankara was designated as Turkey's official capital city on 13 October 1923.
questions.context:
On this day in 1923: Ankara becomes the capital of Turkey.
Ankara (Capital of Turkey): Ankara is the capital city of Turkey. Located in the central part of Anatolia, the city has a population of over 5.3 million residents in its urban center, out of 6 million residents in Ankara Province. Ankara is Turkey's second-largest city by population after Istanbul.

questions.question: Which superhero did Tobey Maguire portray in Sam Raimi's 2002 blockbuster film and its subsequent sequels?
questions.explanation: Tobey Maguire achieved worldwide fame playing Peter Parker in the 2002 film Spider-Man and later reprised the role across multiple films.
questions.context: Tobey Maguire (American actor (born 1975)): Tobias Vincent Maguire, is an American actor and film producer. He began his career in supporting roles, before gaining international recognition and critical praise for his role as Spider-Man in Sam Raimi's 2002 film Spider-Man. Maguire reprised the role in two sequels, Spider-Man 2 (2004) and Spider-Man 3 (2007). He returned to the role in Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021).

questions.question: In the acclaimed drama series Breaking Bad, which character has cerebral palsy and relies on crutches?
questions.explanation: Walter White Jr., portrayed by RJ Mitte, is the son of Walter and Skyler White and lives with cerebral palsy.
questions.context: Walter White Jr. (Fictional character from Breaking Bad): Walter Hartwell White Jr., also known as Flynn White, portrayed by RJ Mitte, is a fictional character in the American crime drama series Breaking Bad. Walt Jr. is the son of protagonist Walter White and his wife Skyler. He has cerebral palsy, as manifested in speech difficulties and impaired motor control, for which he uses crutches. His younger sister is Holly White.

questions.question: Who founded the free crowdsourced online encyclopedia Wikipedia alongside Larry Sanger in 2001?
questions.explanation: Jimmy Wales co-founded Wikipedia with Larry Sanger in 2001 before operations moved under the Wikimedia Foundation.
questions.context: Wikipedia (Free online crowdsourced encyclopedia): Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia written and maintained by a community of volunteer editors, known as Wikipedians, through open collaboration and the wiki software MediaWiki. Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger in 2001, Wikipedia has been hosted since 2003 by the Wikimedia Foundation, an American nonprofit organization funded mainly by donations from readers. Wikipedia is the largest and most read reference work in history.

questions.question: On which Bahamian island did Christopher Columbus make landfall on 12 October 1492?
questions.explanation: Christopher Columbus arrived in the Americas at Guanahaní, an island located in the Bahamas.
questions.context: Columbus Day (National holiday in the Americas): Columbus Day is a national holiday in many countries of the Americas and elsewhere, and a federal holiday in the United States, intended to celebrate the anniversary of the arrival of Christopher Columbus in the Americas. He went ashore at Guanahaní, an island in the Bahamas, on October 12, 1492 [OS]. He built La Navidad on the northwestern coast of the island of Hispaniola in late December 1492, the first European fort in the Americas.
